mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate central bank intervention.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and decreases in industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a demand-driven economic shift toward services, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in resilient consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of interaction instances, or interaction effect Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), sustained accommodative policy generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate borrowing costs remain depressed.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of low-rate periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) relative to the prior quarter compresses equity risk premiums, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of positive GDPC1 growth quarters, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5% for two consecutive months, persistent price pressures generate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in corporate pricing power.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered inflation periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust labor market conditions and strong consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates sustained growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of interaction instances, or interaction effect Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing weakness generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in economic slowdown risks.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC remains above -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
